title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
titleEnglish: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
titleNative: レプリカだって、恋をする。
synonyms: Even a Replica Falls in Love
รักฉันเทียมเธอ
synopsis: On days when Sunao is sick, or not feeling like going to school, she is called to take her place. She was born to this world when Sunao wished to have a substitute. No one knows that she exists, but she tries to do her best for Sunao whenever she is called. One day she talks with Sanada, one of her classmates. They become friends, but soon he notices that she is different from the original Sunao...he was the first one who did. She tells him to talk with her only when she has her hair half-up. Sanada does like she told him, and they enjoy their time together. As they become closer, she realizes that she has special feelings toward Sanada. But she doesn't know what will happen to her...if she, a replica, falls in love. (Source: BookWalker)

synonyms: Wandering Around Another World with Just One Fishing Rod
synopsis: Owari Machida was a professional fisherman who made a name for himself in the media, but his former glory proved short-lived, and he struggles everyday to make ends meet. One day, while out boat fishing, he gets swept away by the waves and fell into the sea, losing consciousness as he downs because of a malfunction of his life jacket. When Owari awakens, the scenery has completely changed—he finds himself in an Isekai... In this world where the culture of fishing has declined, Owari wanders around enjoying fishing with the fishing gear that transmigrated with him, while interacting with the locals... (Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: NonNonBa
titleNative: のんのんばあとオレ
synopsis: Autobiographical tale in which Mizuki narrates the memories of his childhood in the decade of 1930, in Sakaiminato, a small coastal town at the southwest Japan. With nostalgia and tenderness, the mangaka narrates his first years of life within a modest family, the fights with his friends,the school and his first loves. The title character of the book, NonNonBa, is an old mystical and superstitious woman by which Shigeru discovers the world of yokai, supernatural beings and grotesque bestiary of medieval Japanese. Won Best Album at the 2007 Angoulême International Comics Festival.

synopsis: In the Utsusemi District of Toaru City—where Suzuran All-Boys High School towers over the landscape—a young boy named Asada Hibari has moved into the Nakahara Apartments, a place better known as "The Ghost Projects." However, a chance meeting with Kobayashi Sanzou, a resident of the same building, begins to lead his youth toward something hotter and more irreplaceable than anything he’s ever known!! (Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

synonyms: The Girl Who Can Clearly Say "I Love You" Is Unbeatable
synopsis: There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward. [The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki. [Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku. [The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga. However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach. "Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me." "Here, say 'ahh'~♪" "Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?" In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?" (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Gokumon Nadeshiko Koko ni Ari
titleNative: 獄門撫子此処ニ在リ
synopsis: The Gokumon clan - a bloodline from hell. Living in their mysterious stronghold in the ancient capital of Kyoto, they command fear not only from those who wield magic, but also monsters and demons. Nadeshiko Gokumon is the monster-devouring heiress of this wicked family. She is the most beautiful, and the most abominable, girl who comes straight from the flames of hell. However...... "Nadeshiko, I see you are as lovely as your name." The encounter with the most strange, disturbing, and beautiful woman, Amana Ichijiku, who laughs in her face without fear, changes Nadeshiko. Something lurks in the flower ceiling. A human sacrifice packed in a box. A curse that threaten the school. A deceitful beast. A shapeless monster. As the two confront one supernatural challenge after another, they eventually come face to face with the very thing they have been turning away from. "If it weren't for you, I would still be an ogre." A woman with a human soul in an ogre's body and a girl with a monstrous soul in a human body. The connection between the two is a story that will be sealed with blood. (Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)
